atoms.text: Farming has been very important for human survival for thousands of years. Farming allowed societies around the world to settle down, grow larger and still have enough food. However, farming has changed a lot over time. Nowadays, there are two main types of farming. One is called conventional farming, and the other is called organic farming.

Today, the dominant form of farming in the world is called conventional farming. Other terms for it are modern farming or industrial farming. Farming has always been very labour-intensive work, but conventional farming has made it possible to farm larger areas more efficiently. This means that conventional farming has made it possible to get higher amounts of food with less work than in the past.

hint.label: Labour
hint.text: Labour is another way of saying physical work

atoms.text: Conventional farming has been shaped by technological innovation. The introduction of large machines and chemical pesticides and fertilisers have made it easier to grow large amounts of food faster than before. However, there are also disadvantages to conventional farming. The downside is that it often has negative consequences for the environment. In particular, the soil can suffer from the use of chemicals and growing the same type of crop in a large area over a longer time period.

hint.label: Technological innovation
hint.text: Technological innovation means the invention of new things that make people’s lives easier and more comfortable.

instruction.text: Which pictures show typical characteristics of conventional farming? Select the correct picture.

correct1.text: This picture shows the use of chemicals, such as pesticides and fertilisers.
This picture shows a large area which is planted with the same type of crop.
This picture shows an aeroplane spraying crops with chemicals.
This picture shows the use of huge machines in order to farm vast areas of land.

instruction.text: True or false? Select the correct answer.

atoms.a: Conventional farming produces only a small amount of food.
Conventional farming can produce a comparatively large amount of food for less work.
Conventional farming has negative impacts on the environment.
Other terms for conventional farming are modern farming or industrial farming.
